id-20260812-intro-real-estate-9.title: [Property #9] Why Are Bank Appraisals Often Lower Than Selling Price? Fundamentals of Property Valuation

segments.src: > Harga adalah angka yang disepakati dua orang; nilai adalah angka yang bisa dipertanggungjawabkan dengan data — dan penilai properti bekerja dengan tiga cara baku untuk menemukannya.
segments.tr: > Price is a figure agreed upon by two people; value is a figure that can be backed up with data — and property appraisers work with three standard methods to find it.

segments.src: ## Konsep hari ini — Nilai, Harga, dan Biaya itu tiga hal berbeda
segments.tr: ## Today's concept — Value, Price, and Cost are three different things

segments.src: Banyak orang memakai kata "nilai", "harga", dan "biaya" bergantian.
segments.tr: Many people use the words "value", "price", and "cost" interchangeably.

segments.src: Dalam ilmu properti, ketiganya dibedakan tegas:
segments.tr: In property science, the three are clearly distinguished:

segments.src: - **Harga (price)** — angka yang benar-benar dibayar dalam satu transaksi. Bisa terlalu mahal atau terlalu murah, tergantung siapa yang bernegosiasi dan seberapa terburu-buru mereka.
segments.tr: - **Price** — the amount actually paid in a single transaction. It can be too expensive or too cheap, depending on who negotiates and how rushed they are.

segments.src: - **Biaya (cost)** — uang yang dikeluarkan untuk membangun atau memperoleh. Rumah yang menghabiskan Rp 900 juta untuk dibangun tidak otomatis bernilai Rp 900 juta.
segments.tr: - **Cost** — money spent to build or acquire. A house that costs Rp 900 million to build is not automatically worth Rp 900 million.

segments.src: - **Nilai (value)** — estimasi manfaat ekonomi properti pada tanggal tertentu, bagi pasar secara umum.
segments.tr: - **Value** — an estimate of the economic benefit of a property on a specific date, for the market in general.

segments.src: Definisi yang dipakai penilai di Indonesia (Standar Penilaian Indonesia / SPI, yang mengacu ke standar internasional) kira-kira begini: **Nilai Pasar** adalah estimasi jumlah uang pada tanggal penilaian, dari transaksi antara penjual dan pembeli yang sama-sama berminat, sama-sama paham, tanpa paksaan, setelah pemasaran yang memadai.
segments.tr: The definition used by appraisers in Indonesia (Indonesian Valuation Standards / SPI, which refers to international standards) is roughly as follows: **Market Value** is an estimate of the amount of money on the valuation date, from a transaction between a seller and buyer who are both interested, both informed, without coercion, after adequate marketing.

segments.src: Kata kuncinya: *tanpa paksaan* dan *sama-sama paham*.
segments.tr: The key words are: *without coercion* and *both informed*.

segments.src: Karena itu harga BU ("butuh uang") atau harga jual antar-saudara tidak dianggap mencerminkan nilai pasar.
segments.tr: Because of this, BU prices ("need money") or family member sales prices are not considered to reflect market value.

segments.src: **Prinsip-prinsip penilaian** yang paling sering dipakai:
segments.tr: **Valuation principles** most often used:

segments.src: 1. **Penggunaan Tertinggi dan Terbaik (Highest and Best Use/HBU)** — properti dinilai berdasarkan pemanfaatan terbaiknya yang *legal, memungkinkan secara fisik, layak secara finansial, dan paling menguntungkan*. Rumah tua di jalan protokol Bandung bisa dinilai sebagai lahan komersial, bukan sebagai rumah tinggal.
segments.tr: 1. **Highest and Best Use (HBU)** — property is valued based on its best use that is *legal, physically possible, financially feasible, and most profitable*. An old house on a main road in Bandung could be valued as commercial land, not as a residence.

segments.src: 2. **Substitusi** — pembeli rasional tidak akan membayar lebih mahal daripada properti pengganti yang setara. Ini fondasi dari semua perbandingan harga.
segments.tr: 2. **Substitution** — a rational buyer will not pay more than an equivalent substitute property. This is the foundation of all price comparisons.

segments.src: 3. **Antisipasi** — nilai mencerminkan ekspektasi manfaat di masa depan, bukan masa lalu. Ini alasan tanah dekat rencana stasiun LRT naik duluan.
segments.tr: 3. **Anticipation** — value reflects the expectation of benefits in the future, not the past. This is why land near a planned LRT station appreciates first.

segments.src: 4. **Kontribusi** — tiap komponen dinilai dari *tambahan nilai yang diberikannya*, bukan dari biayanya. Kolam renang Rp 200 juta di rumah cluster mungkin hanya menambah nilai Rp 60 juta.
segments.tr: 4. **Contribution** — each component is valued based on the *additional value it adds*, not its cost. A Rp 200 million swimming pool in a cluster home might add only Rp 60 million in value.

segments.src: 5. **Permintaan–penawaran & eksternalitas** — nilai dipengaruhi hal di luar pagar: akses tol, banjir, sekolah, pasar, rencana tata ruang.
segments.tr: 5. **Supply and demand & externalities** — value is influenced by factors outside the property: highway access, flooding, schools, markets, zoning plans.

segments.src: **Tiga pendekatan penilaian** — semuanya sah, dipilih sesuai jenis properti dan ketersediaan data:
segments.tr: **Three valuation approaches** — all are valid, chosen according to property type and data availability:

segments.src: | Pendekatan | Logika dasar | Paling cocok untuk |
segments.tr: | Approach | Basic logic | Best suited for |

segments.src: | **Pendekatan Pasar** (data pasar/perbandingan) | Bandingkan dengan properti sejenis yang baru terjual, lalu sesuaikan perbedaannya | Rumah tinggal, ruko, tanah kavling |
segments.tr: | **Market Approach** (market data/comparison) | Compare with similar properties recently sold, then adjust for differences | Residential homes, shophouses, land lots |

segments.src: | **Pendekatan Biaya** | Nilai tanah + biaya bangun baru − penyusutan | Bangunan baru, properti khusus (pabrik, sekolah, rumah sakit) |
segments.tr: | **Cost Approach** | Land value + new construction cost − depreciation | New buildings, special properties (factories, schools, hospitals) |

segments.src: | **Pendekatan Pendapatan** | Nilai = kemampuan properti menghasilkan uang sewa | Properti komersial: kos, ruko sewa, gudang, perkantoran |
segments.tr: | **Income Approach** | Value = property's ability to generate rental income | Commercial properties: boarding houses, rental shophouses, warehouses, office buildings |

segments.src: Rumus intinya cukup ditulis polos:
segments.tr: The basic formula can be written plainly:

segments.src: Pendekatan Biaya    : Nilai = Nilai Tanah + (Biaya Bangunan Baru − Penyusutan)
segments.tr: Pendekatan Biaya    : Nilai = Nilai Tanah + (Biaya Bangunan Baru − Penyusutan)

segments.src: Pendekatan Pendapatan: Nilai = NOI ÷ Tingkat Kapitalisasi
segments.tr: Pendekatan Pendapatan: Nilai = NOI ÷ Tingkat Kapitalisasi

segments.src: NOI                 : Pendapatan Sewa Efektif − Biaya Operasional
segments.tr: NOI                 : Pendapatan Sewa Efektif − Biaya Operasional

segments.src: Penyusutan sendiri ada tiga sumber: **fisik** (bangunan menua, atap bocor), **fungsional** (desain usang, plafon terlalu rendah untuk gudang modern), dan **ekonomis/eksternal** (lingkungan menurun, jalan di depan jadi satu arah).
segments.tr: Depreciation itself has three sources: **physical** (building aging, leaky roof), **functional** (outdated design, ceiling too low for modern warehouse), and **economic/external** (declining environment, street in front becomes one-way).

segments.src: Terakhir, penilai tidak berhenti di tiga angka.
segments.tr: Finally, the appraiser doesn't stop at three numbers.

segments.src: Ada tahap **rekonsiliasi**: memilih dan memberi bobot pada pendekatan yang datanya paling kuat — bukan sekadar merata-ratakan ketiganya.
segments.tr: There is a **reconciliation** step: choosing and weighting the approach whose data is strongest — not simply averaging the three.

segments.src: ## Dalam keseharian — kasus KPR di Bekasi
segments.tr: ## In everyday life — a mortgage case in Bekasi

segments.src: Bayangkan Rina menemukan rumah dua lantai di Bekasi, LT 90 m² / LB 120 m².
segments.tr: Imagine Rina finds a two-story house in Bekasi, land 90 m² / building 120 m².

segments.src: Penjual pasang harga **Rp 1,2 miliar** dan Rina setuju.
segments.tr: The seller sets the price at **Rp 1.2 billion** and Rina agrees.

segments.src: Ia mengajukan KPR ke bank.
segments.tr: She applies for a mortgage with the bank.

segments.src: Bank mengirim penilai (biasanya dari KJPP — Kantor Jasa Penilai Publik, dengan Penilai Publik berizin Kementerian Keuangan).
segments.tr: The bank sends an appraiser (usually from a KJPP — Public Valuation Office, with an appraiser licensed by the Ministry of Finance).

segments.src: Hasilnya: **Rp 1,05 miliar**.
segments.tr: The result: **Rp 1.05 billion**.

segments.src: Rina kaget — bukankah harganya sudah disepakati?
segments.tr: Rina is shocked — wasn't the price already agreed upon?

segments.src: Yang dilakukan penilai adalah **pendekatan pasar**.
segments.tr: What the appraiser did was use the **market approach**.

segments.src: Ia mengambil tiga rumah pembanding yang benar-benar terjual dalam 6 bulan terakhir di radius sekitar 1 km, lalu menyesuaikan:
segments.tr: She took three comparable homes that actually sold in the last 6 months within about 1 km radius, then adjusted:

segments.src: - Pembanding A: Rp 1,0 M, tapi LT 80 m² → disesuaikan naik untuk selisih luas tanah.
segments.tr: - Comparable A: Rp 1.0 M, but land 80 m² → adjusted up for land area difference.

segments.src: - Pembanding B: Rp 1,15 M, tapi hadap jalan utama dan lebar jalan 8 m → disesuaikan turun.
segments.tr: - Comparable B: Rp 1.15 M, but faces main road and road width 8 m → adjusted down.

segments.src: - Pembanding C: Rp 980 juta, tapi bangunan lebih tua 7 tahun → disesuaikan naik untuk kondisi.
segments.tr: - Comparable C: Rp 980 million, but building 7 years older → adjusted up for condition.

segments.src: Setelah semua penyesuaian, angka bertemu di kisaran Rp 1,03–1,07 M.
segments.tr: After all adjustments, the figure landed in the range of Rp 1.03–1.07 M.

segments.src: Harga penjual Rp 1,2 M ternyata memuat premi negosiasi yang tidak didukung data pasar.
segments.tr: The seller's price of Rp 1.2 M turned out to include a negotiation premium not supported by market data.

segments.src: Konsekuensinya nyata: bank menghitung plafon kredit dari **nilai yang lebih rendah antara harga transaksi dan hasil penilaian**.
segments.tr: The consequence is real: the bank calculates the credit ceiling from **whichever is lower between the transaction price and appraisal result**.

segments.src: Jika bank menyetujui 80% dari Rp 1,05 M, plafonnya Rp 840 juta — artinya Rina harus menyiapkan uang muka Rp 360 juta, bukan Rp 240 juta seperti perkiraannya.
segments.tr: If the bank approves 80% of Rp 1.05 M, the ceiling is Rp 840 million — meaning Rina must prepare a down payment of Rp 360 million, not Rp 240 million as she expected.

segments.src: Selisih Rp 120 juta itu murni akibat perbedaan nilai dan harga.
segments.tr: The Rp 120 million difference is purely due to the difference between value and price.

segments.src: Dua catatan lokal yang sering menyesatkan:
segments.tr: Two local notes that are often misleading:

segments.src: - **NJOP bukan nilai pasar.** NJOP adalah dasar pengenaan PBB dan BPHTB, ditetapkan pemerintah daerah, dan di banyak wilayah jauh di bawah harga pasar. Memakai NJOP untuk menaksir harga jual hampir selalu meleset.
segments.tr: - **NJOP is not market value.** NJOP is the basis for property tax (PBB) and transfer tax (BPHTB), set by local government, and in many areas far below market price. Using NJOP to estimate selling price almost always misses the mark.

segments.src: - **Kalau propertinya menghasilkan sewa, ceritanya berubah.** Misal ruko Rina disewakan Rp 60 juta/tahun dengan biaya operasional (pajak, perawatan, asuransi) Rp 10 juta, maka NOI = Rp 50 juta. Jika tingkat kapitalisasi ruko di area itu 7%, maka `Rp 50 juta ÷ 0,07 = ± Rp 714 juta`. Penyewa yang bagus dan kontrak panjang menaikkan nilai; ruko kosong bertahun-tahun menurunkannya, meski bangunannya sama persis.
segments.tr: - **If the property generates rental income, the story changes.** For example, if Rina's shophouse rents for Rp 60 million/year with operating costs (tax, maintenance, insurance) of Rp 10 million, then NOI = Rp 50 million. If the cap rate for shophouses in that area is 7%, then `Rp 50 million ÷ 0.07 = ± Rp 714 million`. A good tenant and long-term lease increase value; a vacant shophouse for years decreases it, even if the building is identical.

segments.src: ## 3 baris rangkuman
segments.tr: ## 3-line summary

segments.src: 1. Harga adalah hasil negosiasi, biaya adalah pengeluaran, dan nilai adalah estimasi berbasis data pasar pada tanggal tertentu — ketiganya boleh berbeda jauh.
segments.tr: 1. Price is the result of negotiation, cost is expenditure, and value is an estimate based on market data on a specific date — the three can differ greatly.

segments.src: 2. Penilaian berpijak pada prinsip seperti Penggunaan Tertinggi dan Terbaik, substitusi, antisipasi, dan kontribusi — bukan pada seberapa besar uang yang sudah Anda keluarkan.
segments.tr: 2. Valuation is based on principles like Highest and Best Use, substitution, anticipation, and contribution — not on how much money you've already spent.

segments.src: 3. Tiga pendekatan baku (pasar, biaya, pendapatan) dipilih sesuai jenis properti dan ketersediaan data, lalu direkonsiliasi menjadi satu kesimpulan nilai.
segments.tr: 3. Three standard approaches (market, cost, income) are chosen according to property type and data availability, then reconciled into a single value conclusion.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-quiz

segments.src: **1.** Pernyataan mana yang paling tepat tentang nilai dan harga?
segments.tr: **1.** Which statement is most accurate about value and price?

segments.src: a) Harga transaksi selalu sama dengan nilai pasar
segments.tr: a) Transaction price is always equal to market value

segments.src: b) Nilai pasar mengasumsikan penjual dan pembeli sama-sama paham dan tanpa paksaan, sehingga harga BU bisa berbeda dari nilai pasar
segments.tr: b) Market value assumes the seller and buyer are both informed and without coercion, so BU price can differ from market value

segments.src: c) Nilai pasar selalu lebih tinggi daripada harga transaksi
segments.tr: c) Market value is always higher than transaction price

segments.src: d) Biaya membangun menentukan nilai pasar secara langsung
segments.tr: d) Construction cost directly determines market value

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) NJOP yang tertera di SPPT PBB dapat langsung dipakai sebagai nilai pasar properti.
segments.tr: **2.** (True/False) NJOP shown on the property tax assessment can be directly used as the market value of the property.

segments.src: **3.** Sebuah gudang di kawasan industri Cikarang disewakan jangka panjang, dan data transaksi jual-beli gudang sejenis sangat sedikit.
segments.tr: **3.** A warehouse in the Cikarang industrial area is rented long-term, and transaction data for similar warehouses is very limited.

segments.src: Pendekatan mana yang paling tepat dijadikan andalan?
segments.tr: Which approach is most appropriate to rely on?

segments.src: a) Pendekatan pasar
segments.tr: a) Market approach

segments.src: b) Pendekatan biaya
segments.tr: b) Cost approach

segments.src: c) Pendekatan pendapatan
segments.tr: c) Income approach

segments.src: d) Nilai NJOP dikali dua
segments.tr: d) NJOP value times two

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah hari ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's terms

segments.src: - **Nilai Pasar** — estimasi jumlah uang pada tanggal penilaian, dari transaksi wajar antara pihak yang berminat, paham, dan tanpa paksaan.
segments.tr: - **Market Value** — an estimate of the amount of money on the valuation date, from a fair transaction between parties who are interested, informed, and without coercion.

segments.src: - **Penggunaan Tertinggi dan Terbaik (HBU)** — pemanfaatan properti yang legal, mungkin secara fisik, layak finansial, dan paling menguntungkan; menjadi dasar penilaian.
segments.tr: - **Highest and Best Use (HBU)** — property use that is legal, physically possible, financially feasible, and most profitable; serves as the basis for valuation.

segments.src: - **Penyusutan (depresiasi)** — pengurangan nilai bangunan akibat sebab fisik, fungsional, atau ekonomis/eksternal.
segments.tr: - **Depreciation** — reduction in building value due to physical, functional, or economic/external causes.

segments.src: - **NOI (Net Operating Income)** — pendapatan sewa efektif dikurangi biaya operasional, sebelum cicilan kredit dan pajak penghasilan.
segments.tr: - **NOI (Net Operating Income)** — effective rental income minus operating costs, before loan payments and income tax.

segments.src: - **Tingkat Kapitalisasi (cap rate)** — rasio NOI terhadap nilai properti; makin tinggi cap rate, makin rendah nilai untuk NOI yang sama.
segments.tr: - **Capitalization Rate (cap rate)** — the ratio of NOI to property value; the higher the cap rate, the lower the value for the same NOI.

segments.src: - **KJPP** — Kantor Jasa Penilai Publik, kantor tempat Penilai Publik berizin melakukan penilaian resmi, misalnya untuk keperluan KPR atau laporan keuangan.
segments.tr: - **KJPP** — Public Valuation Office, the office where licensed public appraisers conduct official valuations, for example for mortgage or financial reporting purposes.

segments.src: *Jawaban: **1 – b.** Harga adalah hasil satu transaksi tertentu yang bisa dipengaruhi tekanan waktu atau informasi timpang; nilai pasar justru mengasumsikan kondisi wajar tanpa paksaan.
segments.tr: *Answers: **1 – b.** Price is the result of one specific transaction that can be affected by time pressure or asymmetric information; market value instead assumes fair conditions without coercion.

segments.src: **2 – X (salah).** NJOP adalah dasar pengenaan pajak (PBB/BPHTB) yang ditetapkan pemerintah daerah dan di banyak wilayah berada jauh di bawah harga pasar, sehingga tidak bisa disamakan dengan nilai pasar.
segments.tr: **2 – False.** NJOP is the basis for tax assessment (property tax/transfer tax) set by local government and in many areas is far below market price, so it cannot be equated with market value.

segments.src: **3 – c.** Karena properti menghasilkan arus sewa yang jelas sementara data pembanding jual-beli langka, pendekatan pendapatan (kapitalisasi NOI atau DCF) paling dapat diandalkan; pendekatan lain tetap bisa dipakai sebagai pembanding dalam rekonsiliasi.*
segments.tr: **3 – c.** Because the property generates clear rental income while comparable sales data is scarce, the income approach (NOI capitalization or DCF) is most reliable; other approaches can still be used as comparables in reconciliation.*

id-20260812-news-1.title: Destry Damayanti Sole Candidate for BI Governor, DPR Fit and Proper Test to Be Held Amid Rupiah Pressure at Rp17.970

segments.src: ## Presiden Ajukan Nama Tunggal ke DPR
segments.tr: ## President Submits Sole Name to DPR

segments.src: Presiden Prabowo Subianto resmi mengajukan nama Destry Damayanti sebagai calon tunggal Gubernur Bank Indonesia (BI) untuk periode mendatang, menggantikan Perry Warjiyo yang masa jabatannya akan segera berakhir.
segments.tr: President Prabowo Subianto has officially submitted the name of Destry Damayanti as the sole candidate for Governor of Bank Indonesia (BI) for the upcoming term, replacing Perry Warjiyo, whose term is set to end soon.

segments.src: Pengajuan tersebut disampaikan melalui surat presiden (surpres) yang diterima Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat (DPR) pada 10 Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: The submission was made via a presidential letter (surpres) received by the House of Representatives (DPR) on August 10, 2026.

segments.src: Nama Destry Damayanti bukan sosok asing di lingkungan bank sentral.
segments.tr: The name Destry Damayanti is not a stranger within the central bank environment.

segments.src: Ia telah lama menjabat sebagai Deputi Gubernur Senior BI dan dikenal luas di kalangan pelaku pasar keuangan maupun akademisi ekonomi.
segments.tr: She has long served as Senior Deputy Governor of BI and is widely known among financial market players and economic academics.

segments.src: Pencalonannya sebagai kandidat tunggal dinilai mencerminkan preferensi pemerintah terhadap kesinambungan arah kebijakan moneter yang selama ini dijalankan BI.
segments.tr: Her nomination as the sole candidate is considered to reflect the government's preference for the continuity of the monetary policy direction that has been implemented by BI so far.

segments.src: ## Uji Kelayakan Menanti Selesainya Masa Reses
segments.tr: ## Fit and Proper Test Awaits End of Recess

segments.src: Sesuai mekanisme yang diatur dalam undang-undang, calon Gubernur BI yang diajukan presiden wajib melalui uji kelayakan dan kepatutan (fit and proper test) di Komisi XI DPR RI, yang membidangi urusan keuangan dan perbankan.
segments.tr: In accordance with the mechanism regulated by law, the BI Governor candidate submitted by the president must undergo a fit and proper test at Commission XI of the DPR RI, which oversees finance and banking affairs.

segments.src: Proses uji kelayakan terhadap Destry dijadwalkan berlangsung setelah masa reses anggota dewan berakhir pada 14 Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: The fit and proper test process for Destry is scheduled to take place after the parliamentary recess ends on August 14, 2026.

segments.src: Dalam forum tersebut, calon Gubernur BI biasanya diminta memaparkan visi dan misi terkait kebijakan moneter, strategi menjaga stabilitas nilai tukar, pengendalian inflasi, hingga langkah menjaga kepercayaan pasar di tengah dinamika ekonomi global.
segments.tr: In that forum, the BI Governor candidate is usually asked to present their vision and mission regarding monetary policy, strategies for maintaining exchange rate stability, inflation control, and steps to maintain market confidence amidst global economic dynamics.

segments.src: Anggota Komisi XI juga lazim mengajukan pertanyaan seputar rekam jejak serta pandangan calon terhadap tantangan ekonomi terkini.
segments.tr: Members of Commission XI also typically ask questions regarding the candidate's track record and views on current economic challenges.

segments.src: Hasil uji kelayakan tersebut selanjutnya akan dibawa ke rapat paripurna DPR untuk mendapatkan persetujuan, sebelum calon terpilih resmi dilantik menjadi Gubernur BI.
segments.tr: The results of the fit and proper test will subsequently be brought to a DPR plenary session for approval before the elected candidate is officially inaugurated as BI Governor.

segments.src: ## Rupiah Tertekan Jelang Uji Kelayakan
segments.tr: ## Rupiah Under Pressure Ahead of Fit and Proper Test

segments.src: Momentum uji kelayakan ini berlangsung di tengah tekanan terhadap nilai tukar rupiah, yang belakangan bergerak melemah hingga mendekati level Rp17.970 per dolar Amerika Serikat.
segments.tr: The momentum of this fit and proper test occurs amidst pressure on the rupiah exchange rate, which has recently weakened to near the level of Rp17.970 per US dollar.

segments.src: Pelemahan ini disebut sejumlah analis pasar berkaitan dengan kombinasi faktor eksternal, seperti pergerakan indeks dolar AS dan ekspektasi arah suku bunga bank sentral Amerika Serikat (The Fed), serta faktor domestik terkait sentimen investor menjelang pergantian kepemimpinan di BI.
segments.tr: This weakening is attributed by a number of market analysts to a combination of external factors, such as the movement of the US dollar index and expectations regarding the direction of US central bank (The Fed) interest rates, as well as domestic factors related to investor sentiment ahead of the leadership change at BI.

segments.src: Pergerakan rupiah yang mendekati level psikologis Rp18.000 ini menjadi salah satu perhatian utama pelaku pasar, mengingat stabilitas nilai tukar merupakan salah satu mandat utama BI selain pengendalian inflasi.
segments.tr: The movement of the rupiah, which is approaching the psychological level of Rp18.000, has become one of the main concerns for market players, considering that exchange rate stability is one of BI's main mandates alongside inflation control.

segments.src: Sejumlah pengamat ekonomi menilai kejelasan arah kepemimpinan baru bank sentral dapat memberikan sinyal kepastian bagi pasar, sehingga proses uji kelayakan di DPR turut menjadi sorotan pelaku pasar keuangan dalam beberapa hari ke depan.
segments.tr: A number of economic observers assess that clarity on the direction of the new central bank leadership can provide a signal of certainty for the market, so the fit and proper test process in the DPR is also a highlight for financial market players in the next few days.

segments.src: ## Tantangan ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Challenges Ahead

segments.src: Apabila lolos uji kelayakan dan mendapat persetujuan DPR, Destry Damayanti akan menghadapi sejumlah tantangan pada awal masa jabatannya, termasuk menjaga stabilitas rupiah di tengah ketidakpastian ekonomi global, mengelola cadangan devisa, serta melanjutkan koordinasi kebijakan moneter dan fiskal bersama pemerintah.
segments.tr: If she passes the fit and proper test and receives DPR approval, Destry Damayanti will face a number of challenges at the beginning of her term, including maintaining rupiah stability amidst global economic uncertainty, managing foreign exchange reserves, and continuing monetary and fiscal policy coordination with the government.

segments.src: Publik dan pelaku pasar kini menantikan hasil uji kelayakan di Komisi XI DPR sebagai penentu arah kepemimpinan Bank Indonesia ke depan.
segments.tr: The public and market players are now awaiting the results of the fit and proper test at Commission XI of the DPR as a determinant of the future direction of Bank Indonesia's leadership.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun berdasarkan informasi yang berkembang dan dapat diperbarui seiring perkembangan proses di DPR.*
segments.tr: *This article was compiled based on developing information and may be updated as the process in the DPR progresses.*

id-20260812-news-3.title: August 2026 CPO Reference Price Drops Slightly to US$996.52/Ton, India's Demand Weakens

segments.src: Kementerian Perdagangan resmi menetapkan Harga Referensi (HR) crude palm oil (CPO) untuk periode Agustus 2026 sebesar US$996,52 per ton.
segments.tr: The Ministry of Trade has officially set the Reference Price (HR) for crude palm oil (CPO) for the August 2026 period at US$996.52 per ton.

segments.src: Angka ini turun sekitar 0,44 persen dibandingkan penetapan bulan sebelumnya.
segments.tr: This figure has decreased by about 0.44 percent compared to the previous month's setting.

segments.src: Meski secara persentase penurunannya tergolong kecil, sinyal ini penting untuk dicermati karena HR CPO menjadi acuan langsung bagi besaran bea keluar dan pungutan ekspor, yang pada akhirnya ikut memengaruhi harga tandan buah segar (TBS) di tingkat petani.
segments.tr: Although the percentage decrease is relatively small, this signal is important to monitor because the CPO HR serves as a direct benchmark for export duties and levies, which ultimately also affect the price of fresh fruit bunches (TBS) at the farmer level.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana Harga Referensi Ditetapkan
segments.tr: ## How the Reference Price is Determined

segments.src: HR CPO disusun setiap bulan oleh Kementerian Perdagangan berdasarkan rata-rata harga yang terbentuk di sejumlah bursa acuan, antara lain Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange dan Bursa Berjangka Jakarta, dengan mempertimbangkan pula perkembangan harga di pasar fisik dalam periode berjalan.
segments.tr: The CPO HR is compiled monthly by the Ministry of Trade based on the average prices formed on several reference exchanges, including the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange and the Jakarta Futures Exchange, while also considering price developments in the physical market during the current period.

segments.src: Mekanisme ini dirancang agar kebijakan bea keluar dan pungutan ekspor CPO bisa menyesuaikan secara berkala dengan kondisi pasar global, bukan mengikuti angka yang statis.
segments.tr: This mechanism is designed so that CPO export duty and levy policies can adjust periodically to global market conditions, rather than following a static figure.

segments.src: Dengan HR yang lebih rendah pada Agustus 2026, ruang gerak harga di pasar internasional relatif melemah dibandingkan bulan-bulan sebelumnya.
segments.tr: With a lower HR in August 2026, the price movement room in the international market is relatively weaker compared to previous months.

segments.src: Ini mengonfirmasi bahwa tekanan pada harga CPO bukan sekadar fluktuasi harian, melainkan tren yang cukup konsisten dalam beberapa pekan terakhir.
segments.tr: This confirms that the pressure on CPO prices is not merely a daily fluctuation, but rather a fairly consistent trend over the past few weeks.

segments.src: ## Permintaan India Jadi Faktor Utama
segments.tr: ## India's Demand Becomes Main Factor

segments.src: India selama ini dikenal sebagai salah satu pembeli minyak sawit terbesar di dunia, dengan volume impor yang besar untuk memenuhi kebutuhan konsumsi minyak goreng domestiknya.
segments.tr: India has long been known as one of the largest palm oil buyers in the world, with large import volumes to meet its domestic cooking oil consumption needs.

segments.src: Ketika permintaan dari India melambat, dampaknya cukup terasa pada keseimbangan permintaan-penawaran global karena porsi impor negara tersebut yang signifikan terhadap total perdagangan CPO dunia.
segments.tr: When demand from India slows down, the impact is quite palpable on the global supply-demand balance due to the country's significant import share of total world CPO trade.

segments.src: Pelemahan permintaan ini umumnya dipicu oleh kombinasi beberapa faktor, seperti tingkat stok minyak nabati yang masih relatif tinggi di gudang-gudang importir India, pergerakan nilai tukar rupee yang memengaruhi daya beli importir, serta persaingan harga dengan minyak nabati substitusi seperti minyak kedelai dan minyak bunga matahari yang sewaktu-waktu bisa lebih kompetitif.
segments.tr: This weakening demand is generally triggered by a combination of several factors, such as vegetable oil stock levels that are still relatively high in Indian importers' warehouses, the movement of the rupee exchange rate which affects importers' purchasing power, and price competition with substitute vegetable oils such as soybean oil and sunflower oil which can sometimes be more competitive.

segments.src: Selain itu, kebijakan tarif impor yang diberlakukan otoritas India dari waktu ke waktu turut menjadi pertimbangan pelaku usaha dalam mengatur volume pembelian.
segments.tr: In addition, import tariff policies implemented by Indian authorities from time to time also become a consideration for business actors in managing purchase volumes.

segments.src: ## Efek Berantai ke Bea Keluar dan Pungutan Ekspor
segments.tr: ## Chain Effect on Export Duties and Levies

segments.src: Karena HR CPO menjadi dasar perhitungan bea keluar dan pungutan ekspor, penurunan harga referensi umumnya berujung pada penyesuaian ke bawah untuk kedua komponen tersebut.
segments.tr: Because the CPO HR serves as the basis for calculating export duties and levies, a drop in the reference price generally leads to a downward adjustment for both components.

segments.src: Bagi eksportir dan perusahaan pengolahan sawit, hal ini sedikit meringankan beban biaya ekspor di tengah harga jual yang juga melemah.
segments.tr: For exporters and palm oil processing companies, this slightly eases the burden of export costs amidst selling prices that are also weakening.

segments.src: Namun bagi penerimaan negara dari sektor sawit, tren ini berarti potensi pendapatan dari bea keluar dan pungutan ekspor turut mengalami tekanan, sehingga perlu diimbangi dengan strategi hilirisasi dan diversifikasi pasar ekspor agar kontribusi sektor sawit terhadap devisa tetap terjaga.
segments.tr: However, for state revenues from the palm oil sector, this trend means potential income from export duties and levies is also under pressure, so it needs to be balanced with downstream strategies and export market diversification so that the palm oil sector's contribution to foreign exchange remains maintained.

segments.src: ## Dampak ke Petani Sawit
segments.tr: ## Impact on Palm Oil Farmers

segments.src: Bagi petani, terutama pekebun swadaya, pergerakan HR CPO biasanya turut memengaruhi formula penetapan harga TBS di tingkat provinsi maupun kabupaten.
segments.tr: For farmers, especially independent smallholders, the movement of the CPO HR usually also affects the TBS pricing formula at the provincial and regency levels.

segments.src: Ketika harga referensi melemah, ada risiko harga beli TBS oleh pabrik kelapa sawit ikut tertekan, meski besarannya bergantung pula pada faktor lain seperti rendemen, biaya produksi, dan kebijakan harga di masing-masing daerah.
segments.tr: When the reference price weakens, there is a risk that the purchase price of TBS by palm oil mills will also be suppressed, although the amount also depends on other factors such as oil extraction rate, production costs, and pricing policies in each region.

segments.src: Kondisi ini membuat kalangan petani dan asosiasi pekebun sawit umumnya berharap ada langkah mitigasi, misalnya melalui optimalisasi program peremajaan sawit rakyat dan penguatan hilirisasi produk turunan CPO agar nilai tambah tidak hanya bergantung pada harga bahan mentah.
segments.tr: This condition makes farmers and palm oil smallholder associations generally hope for mitigation steps, for example through optimizing the people's palm oil replanting program and strengthening the downstreaming of CPO derivative products so that added value does not solely depend on raw material prices.

segments.src: ## Konteks Pasar Global yang Lebih Luas
segments.tr: ## Broader Global Market Context

segments.src: Pelemahan permintaan India terjadi di tengah dinamika pasar minyak nabati global yang juga dipengaruhi oleh produksi dari negara produsen utama lain, termasuk Malaysia sebagai pesaing terdekat Indonesia.
segments.tr: The weakening of India's demand occurs amidst global vegetable oil market dynamics which are also influenced by production from other major producer countries, including Malaysia as Indonesia's closest competitor.

segments.src: Pergerakan harga minyak kedelai di Amerika Serikat, kebijakan biodiesel berbasis sawit di dalam negeri, serta sentimen harga energi turut menjadi variabel yang saling memengaruhi pergerakan harga CPO di pasar internasional.
segments.tr: Soybean oil price movements in the United States, domestic palm-based biodiesel policies, and energy price sentiment also become variables that mutually influence CPO price movements in the international market.

segments.src: ## Proyeksi ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Future Projections

segments.src: Pelaku industri umumnya memantau ketat pergerakan stok dan pola pembelian dari India serta negara importir besar lainnya seperti Tiongkok dan Pakistan sebagai indikator arah harga CPO pada bulan-bulan berikutnya.
segments.tr: Industry players generally closely monitor stock movements and purchasing patterns from India and other major importing countries such as China and Pakistan as indicators of the direction of CPO prices in the following months.

segments.src: Selama permintaan belum menunjukkan pemulihan yang signifikan, tekanan terhadap HR CPO berpotensi berlanjut, meski besaran perubahannya bisa saja bervariasi tergantung perkembangan pasokan dari negara produsen dan kebijakan perdagangan masing-masing negara importir.
segments.tr: As long as demand does not show a significant recovery, pressure on the CPO HR has the potential to continue, although the magnitude of the change may vary depending on supply developments from producer countries and the trade policies of each importing country.

segments.src: Bagi pelaku usaha di dalam negeri, situasi ini menjadi pengingat pentingnya strategi diversifikasi pasar ekspor dan penguatan program hilirisasi sawit, agar sektor ini tetap resilien terhadap fluktuasi permintaan dari satu negara tujuan ekspor utama saja.
segments.tr: For domestic business actors, this situation serves as an important reminder of the importance of export market diversification strategies and strengthening palm oil downstream programs, so that this sector remains resilient against demand fluctuations from just one major export destination country.

id-20260812-news-2.title: Proposed Name Change for Asset Forfeiture Bill to Asset Protection Bill: How Trustworthy Is This Law?

segments.src: Wacana perubahan nama RUU Perampasan Aset menjadi RUU Melindungi Aset kembali mengemuka dalam rapat dengar pendapat Komisi III DPR pada 11 Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: The discourse on changing the name of the Asset Forfeiture Bill to the Asset Protection Bill resurfaced during a hearing of House Commission III on August 11, 2026.

segments.src: Usulan ini disampaikan oleh kalangan pakar kebijakan publik yang diundang dalam forum tersebut, dengan alasan utama agar semangat regulasi lebih menonjolkan sisi perlindungan hak warga negara, bukan semata-mata kewenangan negara untuk menyita harta kekayaan yang diduga berasal dari tindak pidana.
segments.tr: This proposal was put forward by public policy experts invited to the forum, with the main argument being that the spirit of the regulation should emphasize the protection of citizens' rights rather than merely the state's authority to confiscate assets allegedly originating from criminal acts.

segments.src: ## Latar Belakang Usulan
segments.tr: ## Background of the Proposal

segments.src: RUU Perampasan Aset sejatinya sudah lama didorong sebagai instrumen hukum untuk mengembalikan kerugian negara akibat korupsi dan kejahatan lain, terutama pada kasus yang sulit dibuktikan lewat jalur pidana konvensional.
segments.tr: The Asset Forfeiture Bill has long been promoted as a legal instrument to recover state losses due to corruption and other crimes, especially in cases that are difficult to prove through conventional criminal channels.

segments.src: Namun, sejak awal pembahasan, RUU ini kerap menuai perdebatan karena mekanisme perampasan aset tanpa putusan pidana (non-conviction based asset forfeiture) dinilai berpotensi bersinggungan dengan hak kepemilikan dan asas praduga tak bersalah.
segments.tr: However, since the beginning of the discussion, this bill has often drawn debate because the mechanism of asset forfeiture without a criminal conviction (non-conviction based asset forfeiture) is considered to potentially clash with property rights and the presumption of innocence.

segments.src: Dalam forum dengar pendapat tersebut, sejumlah pakar menilai penggunaan istilah "perampasan" berkonotasi represif dan berpotensi menimbulkan kekhawatiran publik terhadap penyalahgunaan wewenang.
segments.tr: In the hearing forum, a number of experts considered that the use of the term "forfeiture" has a repressive connotation and has the potential to raise public concerns regarding the abuse of authority.

segments.src: Karena itu, mereka mengusulkan nama baru yang dianggap lebih mencerminkan tujuan substantif beleid ini, yakni melindungi aset negara sekaligus memastikan hak-hak warga tetap terjaga selama proses hukum berlangsung.
segments.tr: Therefore, they proposed a new name considered to better reflect the substantive goal of this bill, which is to protect state assets while ensuring that citizens' rights remain safeguarded during the legal process.

segments.src: ## Sepuluh Prinsip yang Diusulkan
segments.tr: ## Ten Proposed Principles

segments.src: Sebagai bagian dari usulan tersebut, para pakar turut mengajukan sepuluh prinsip perlindungan yang diharapkan menjadi rujukan dalam penyusunan pasal-pasal RUU, di antaranya:
segments.tr: As part of the proposal, the experts also put forward ten protection principles expected to become a reference in drafting the bill's articles, among them:

segments.src: 1. Kepastian hukum dan kejelasan definisi aset yang dapat dirampas.
segments.tr: 1. Legal certainty and clarity of the definition of assets that can be forfeited.

segments.src: 2. Jaminan proses peradilan yang adil (due process) sebelum aset dieksekusi.
segments.tr: 2. Guarantee of a fair trial process (due process) before assets are executed.

segments.src: 3. Hak pemilik aset untuk mengajukan pembelaan dan banding.
segments.tr: 3. The right of asset owners to submit defenses and appeals.

segments.src: 4. Pembatasan kewenangan aparat agar tidak disalahgunakan di luar konteks tindak pidana.
segments.tr: 4. Limitation of officials' authority so that it is not abused outside the context of criminal acts.

segments.src: 5. Transparansi dan akuntabilitas pengelolaan aset yang telah disita negara.
segments.tr: 5. Transparency and accountability in the management of assets seized by the state.

segments.src: 6. Perlindungan terhadap pihak ketiga yang beritikad baik.
segments.tr: 6. Protection of third parties acting in good faith.

segments.src: 7. Mekanisme pengawasan independen terhadap pelaksanaan undang-undang.
segments.tr: 7. Independent oversight mechanism for the implementation of the law.

segments.src: 8. Batas waktu yang jelas dalam setiap tahapan proses hukum.
segments.tr: 8. Clear time limits in every stage of the legal process.

segments.src: 9. Perlindungan terhadap kebebasan berekspresi, termasuk kerja jurnalistik dan aktivitas politik yang sah.
segments.tr: 9. Protection of freedom of expression, including journalistic work and legitimate political activity.

segments.src: 10. Evaluasi berkala terhadap dampak implementasi RUU terhadap hak asasi manusia.
segments.tr: 10. Periodic evaluation of the impact of the bill's implementation on human rights.

segments.src: ## Kekhawatiran yang Masih Mengemuka
segments.tr: ## Remaining Concerns

segments.src: Meski usulan penggantian nama dan penambahan prinsip perlindungan ini disambut sebagai langkah positif oleh sebagian pihak, tidak sedikit pula yang tetap bersikap hati-hati.
segments.tr: Although the proposal to change the name and add these protection principles has been welcomed as a positive step by some parties, quite a few remain cautious.

segments.src: Kalangan masyarakat sipil dan organisasi pers menyoroti bahwa perubahan nama semata tidak otomatis mengubah substansi kewenangan yang diatur dalam RUU.
segments.tr: Civil society groups and press organizations highlighted that a mere name change does not automatically alter the substance of the authority regulated in the bill.

segments.src: Mereka mengingatkan agar sepuluh prinsip yang diusulkan benar-benar dituangkan secara eksplisit dan mengikat dalam batang tubuh undang-undang, bukan sekadar menjadi narasi dalam konsiderans atau penjelasan umum.
segments.tr: They reminded that the ten proposed principles must be explicitly and bindingly formulated in the body of the law, rather than merely becoming a narrative in the considerations or general explanation.

segments.src: Kekhawatiran utama yang disuarakan adalah potensi penyalahgunaan kewenangan perampasan aset untuk menekan pihak-pihak yang kritis terhadap pemerintah, termasuk aktivis, tokoh oposisi, maupun awak media.
segments.tr: The main concern voiced is the potential abuse of asset forfeiture authority to suppress parties critical of the government, including activists, opposition figures, and media crew.

segments.src: Jika definisi "aset hasil kejahatan" dirumuskan terlalu luas atau multitafsir, beleid ini dikhawatirkan dapat digunakan di luar tujuan awalnya untuk memberantas korupsi dan pencucian uang.
segments.tr: If the definition of "proceeds of crime" is formulated too broadly or has multiple interpretations, it is feared that this law could be used outside its initial purpose of eradicating corruption and money laundering.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana Selanjutnya?
segments.tr: ## What's Next?

segments.src: Hingga rapat dengar pendapat tersebut berakhir, usulan perubahan nama dan sepuluh prinsip perlindungan itu belum menjadi keputusan final.
segments.tr: Until the hearing concluded, the proposal for a name change and the ten protection principles had not become a final decision.

segments.src: Pembahasan di tingkat Komisi III DPR disebut akan berlanjut, dengan melibatkan lebih banyak masukan dari akademisi, penegak hukum, serta perwakilan masyarakat sipil sebelum RUU ini dibawa ke tahap pembahasan lebih lanjut.
segments.tr: Discussions at the level of House Commission III are said to continue, involving more input from academics, law enforcement, and civil society representatives before the bill is brought to the stage of further discussion.

segments.src: Publik disarankan untuk terus memantau perkembangan resmi dari DPR dan pemerintah, mengingat rincian pasal serta rumusan akhir RUU ini masih dapat berubah signifikan seiring proses legislasi yang berjalan.
segments.tr: The public is advised to continue monitoring official developments from the House and the government, considering that the article details and final formulation of this bill can still change significantly along with the ongoing legislative process.

segments.src: Keberhasilan RUU ini dalam mendapatkan kepercayaan publik pada akhirnya akan sangat bergantung pada seberapa konsisten prinsip perlindungan hak warga benar-benar diwujudkan dalam pasal-pasal yang mengikat secara hukum, bukan hanya pada perubahan judul semata.
segments.tr: The success of this bill in gaining public trust will ultimately depend heavily on how consistently the principle of protecting citizens' rights is truly realized in legally binding articles, not just on a title change alone.
